questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

2, 5, 11, 23, ?
questions.solution:
The relation between the numbers is as follows,

2 + 3 = 5

5 + (3 × 2) = 5 + 6 = 11

11 + (6 × 2) = 11 + 12 = 23

Hence, the next number is 23 + (12 × 2) = 23 + 24 = 47

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd number pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
Out of the given options, 13 - 168 is odd one because in all other options 2nd term is one more than the square of 1st term i.e.

7 - 50 → 7² + 1 = 49 + 1 = 50

11 - 122 → 11² + 1 = 121 + 1 = 122

15 - 226 → 15² + 1 = 225 + 1 = 226

But in 13 - 168 → 13² + 1 = 169 + 1 = 170 which is not equal to 168.

Thus, 13 - 168 is odd one.

questions.solution:
Out of the given options, 8 - 96 is odd one because in all other options 2nd term is multiple of 1st term and one more than the 1st term i.e.

7 - 56 → 7 × (7 + 1) = 7 × 8 = 56

10 - 110 → 10 × (10 + 1) = 10 × 11 = 110

9 - 90 → 9 × (9 + 1) = 9 × 10 = 90

But in 8 - 96 → 8 × (8 + 1) = 8 × 9 = 72 which is not equal to 96.

Thus, 8 - 96 is odd one.

questions.question: If 85 × 5 - 3 = 20 and 18 × 2 - 1 = 10, then 100 × 20 - 5 = ?
questions.solution:
The explanation is as follows,

Here sign “×“ denotes division and “-“denotes addition i.e.

85 × 5 - 3 → 85 ÷ 5 + 3 = 17 + 3 = 20.

18 × 2 - 1 → 18 ÷ 2 + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10.

Similarly, 100 × 20 - 5 → 100 ÷ 20 + 5 = 5 + 5 = 10.

Hence, 10 is the correct option.

questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs the equation will be correct?

25 + 18 ÷ 2 - 4 = 20
questions.solution:
The given equation is: 25 + 18 ÷ 2 - 4 = 20

Let’s check each option,

+ and ÷ → 25 ÷ 18 + 2 - 4 = - 0.611 ≠ 20.

÷ and - → 25 + 18 - 2 ÷ 4 = 42.5 ≠ 20.

+ and - → 25 - 18 ÷ 2 + 4 = 20 = 20.

Hence, by interchanging + and - the equation will be correct.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some pen are black.

II. Some pen are blue.

III. No black is red.

**Conclusions:**

I. No pen is red.

II. Some blue are black.

III. Some black are pens.
questions.solution:
Consider the following least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f864879c90bada736f257170b4220b1d2bbff8b4933401b48d707e57d2dcb78.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No pen is red → False (It is possible but not definite).

II. Some blue are black → False (It is possible but not definite).

III. Some black are pens → True (It is definitely true as some black are pens).

Hence, only III follows.

questions.question: Present ages of A and B are in ratio 3 : 5. 7 years later B's age will be twice the age of C. If C celebrated his 10th birthday 4 years ago, then what is the present age (in years) of A?
questions.solution:
Given data,

Ratio of present ages of A and B is 3 : 5.

Let the present age of A be 3x.

Let the present age of B be 5x.

The age of B after 7 years will be (5x + 7) which is equal to twice age of C.

Present age of C = 10 + 4 = 14.

The age of C after 7 years = 14 + 7 = 21.

Thus,

5x + 7 = 2 × 21 → 5x = 42 - 7 = 35.

x = 7.

Present age of A is 3x, 3 × 7 = 21.

Thus, 21 years is the correct answer.
